name: A Husband
overview: Scripture presents the role of a husband as one of faithfulness, love, and unity with his wife, emphasizing the sacredness of the marital bond as seen in Genesis 2:24 where a man cleaves to his wife to become one flesh. A husband is called to rejoice in and cherish the wife of his youth, recognizing her as a blessing and a prudent gift from the Lord (Proverbs 5:18, 19:14). The relationship is a covenant witnessed by God, demanding loyalty and integrity (Malachi 2:14), while also encouraging joy and companionship throughout life (Ecclesiastes 9:9). Finding a wife is portrayed as finding a good thing that brings favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22), highlighting both the responsibility and blessing of husbandhood.
